items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about the Ken Burns jazz, did you see that? [INTERVIEWEE] That sucked, man.

ctx.x: I have learned -- I am cool about it. It bothered me at one time but it doesn’t bother me now because they lose. But you know the stuff that they play, that I hear, that they play, it’s -- I ain’t going to say nothing about it because -­
I think we understand what you are saying or what you are not saying. What about the Ken Burns jazz, did you see that?
